title: Cowboys LB Donovan Ezeiruaku had hip surgery

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cowboys LB Donovan Ezeiruaku had hip surgery
sources.description: Donovan Ezeiruaku is set for a key role at linebacker for the Cowboys as they transition to a 3-4 base look under new coordinator Christian Parker, but he'll have some rehab work to do before he'll be able to get on the field.
